mcqs.question:
With reference to France’s proposed social-media restrictions for children, consider the following statements:
Statement A: France proposed the ban for users under 16 years of age.
Statement B: Australia had already imposed a ban for users under 16 years of age.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Statement A is false because France proposed the ban for users under 15 years of age. Statement B is true because Australia had imposed a ban for users under 16 years of age.
